experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion under liquidity friction and order flow imbalance
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly price deviations exceeding 3% of VWAP from its 20-hour moving average are statistically likely to revert within the next 1-2 hours due to intraday liquidity friction and order flow imbalance, despite apparent momentum signals.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 20-hour lookback, the BTC-USD hourly VWAP reversion signal (price deviation > 0.03 from VWAP) fails to produce a statistically significant mean reversion in the next 1-2 hours, with no observable liquidity friction or order flow imbalance, then the hypothesis is falsified.
